title.rendered: The Garden Court Hotel Palo Alto DJ

content.rendered:
Dinner – GARDEN COURT

7.15 announce NOT for the first time mr and mrs chen

7.17 S&K say hello – short welcome thank you

7:23 S&K – invite Brian Lee up to Bless our food

7:24 Brian does a quick prayer for our food

Matt – introduces lisa for MOH Speech

MOH Speech [3 min] Lisa intro Jace

7:29 Best Man Speech [3 min] Jace intro LSN and PP

7:32 LSN and PP Speech [4 min total]

Matt – S&K will be coming around tables for pictures – stay near by

Photobooth will cose at 9:30 make sure you stop by – scrapbook

8:20 cheers to something – APC speech – right after slideshow

9:00 Only half hr left of Photo Booth

Kirstie and Derek – pack up and bring all to K’s hotel room

Emily will have key to K room – store valuables

clean up crew – Jason and Lisa

pack up all table numbers/signs -> box 6
